description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers regenerating THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md after a ledger change, and asking whether notices are in sync. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (drafting a new ledger entry, running a similarity scan, generic changelog/readme updates) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: the borrows ledger just got a new entry, regenerate the notices file
are our third-party notices up to date with provenance/borrows.jsonl?
lint_provenance says NOTICES.md is out of sync, fix that
regenerate the credits file from the ledger
rebuild THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md after I appended to borrows.jsonl
draft a new ledger entry for this snippet I want to borrow from an MIT repo
scan this diff for copied code against known OSS
update the CHANGELOG for this release
queries.note: unrelated generated doc, not the provenance ledger

queries.q: add a new section to the README about installation
queries.note: generic README editing, no ledger involved

queries.q: check whether this dependency's license is compatible with GPL
queries.note: license compatibility check on a new dep, not notices regeneration
